title: Nightscout deployment plan (draft, read-derived from cgm-remote-monitor ed2ced00 deploy/multitenant/config.js)

baseDomain.description: Suffix under which a tenant's generated label becomes its default permanent primary alias.

profile.description: single: one `nightscout single` process on MongoDB. multitenant: the fixed application cohort on PostgreSQL and a secrets provider.

publicBind.description: Where the edge publishes; the only published address.

privateTransport.description: The cohort's private participant transport. tcp is MT-ENDPOINT-TRANSPORT and is not accepted yet.

trustedPeers.description: Immediate peers whose Host/forwarded headers the app may trust, and TRUST_PROXY. Empty refuses to start a multitenant role (decisions.md, peer-list trust). Configuration, never a provider.

reservedNames.description: Operator additions to the project's reserved-name floor.

internalName.description: Operator-controlled resolution label for canonical-internal mode. Not a URL, not a credential.

host.description: ASCII DNS name, no port (lib/tenant-resolution hostname rules).

expiresAt.description: ephemeral only; expiry changes reachability, never ownership.

policy.description: Alias policy binding. The native device credential path is unaffected (D17).

settings.description: Operator-visible non-secret settings projection; owner values live in the tenant database.

secretRefs.description: Name → reference understood by the secrets provider or the binding's secret store (file path, mount, key name). Never a value.

secrets.description: Interface: core lib/secrets createSecrets providerFor. Reference: vault-transit.

registry.description: Interface: resolver snapshot source. Reference: registry-postgres.

identity.description: Interface: core generic OIDC adapter. Reference profiles: authentik, kratos.

aliasIssuer.description: Interface: ephemeral alias issuance behind the registry contract.

aliasPolicy.description: Interface: may an owner claim or choose a name (pattern, length, reserved list, cooling-off on release). Default: owner claims disabled, generated label only.

scheme.description: Built-in default: DNS-safe lowercase label from a CSPRNG, two leading letters, fixed length, checked against the reserved list; used as the internal name and the default primary alias label.

renameTransitionDays.description: After an owner claim, the previous label stays as an ephemeral alias for this many days so configured uploaders keep working.

name.description: A registered provider name. Never a module path.
